about: Every known name of each master craft, deduplicated by 'norm'. Latin names are folded (accents removed, lower case, punctuation to single spaces); Indic names keep their script in 'norm' and carry an ASCII 'latin' key. 'source' is the most trusted origin, 'sources' every origin. PROPOSED rows are machine guesses (fuzzy code mapping, script-to-script transliteration) that the matcher must not use for an exact hit. A 'norm' listed under 'collisions' names more than one craft and is never an exact match on its own.
